theorems.name: Submission.simon_submanifold_exists_closedBall_isCompact_inter
theorems.statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (r : ℕ∞) (M : Set (Rn N)), Chapter02.IsSimonSubmanifold (E := Rn n) r M → ∀ y ∈ M, ∀ O : Set (Rn N), IsOpen O → y ∈ O → ∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ closedBall y ρ ⊆ O ∧ IsCompact (M ∩ closedBall y ρ)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
